{"type":"text","text":"I'll help you add Rodauth authentication to your Rails app. Here's the implementation:

## 1. Gemfile

Add the Rodauth gem to your Gemfile:

```ruby
# Gemfile
gem 'rodauth-rails'
```

## 2. Configuration

Create the Rodauth initializer:

```ruby
# config/initializers/rodauth.rb
require 'rodauth/rails'

Rails.application.config rodauth do
  # Use cookie-based sessions for traditional web auth
  use :rodauth_app
  
  # Or use JWT tokens for API authentication
  # use :rodauth_jwt
end
```

## 3. Routes

Add authentication routes to your config/routes.rb:

```ruby
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  rodauth_rails(
    only: [:login, :logout, :create_account, :view]
  )
end
```

## 5. User Model

Add authentication methods to your User model:

```ruby
# app/models/user.rb
class User < ApplicationRecord
  include Rodauth::Rails::Model
  
  # Add authentication methods
  def rodauth_rails_app
    # Use cookie-based sessions for traditional web auth
    use :rodauth_app
  end
  
  def rodauth_rails_jwt
    # Use JWT tokens for API authentication
    use :rodauth_jwt
  end
end
```
